question: The height of Mt Godwin Austin (K-2) is ______ m.
solution:
The correct answer is __**8611**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mt Godwin Austin (K-2)**

 
 
• Mt Godwin Austin is located at **8,611 meters** above sea level.
 
• It is the **second-highest **mountain on Earth, after Mount Everest.
 
• It lies in the **Karakoram range.**
 
• It is partially in the Gilgit-Baltistan region of Pakistan-administered Kashmir and partially in a China-administered territory of the Kashmir region.
 
• The other nicknames are **K2, the King of Mountains, the Mountaineers' Mountain **and **the Mountain of Mountains.**
